subject: POC Kickoff Recovery: split sessions & pre-checks
messages:
From: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@acme-corp.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme IT Ops <itops@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2027-08-26T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff — Aug 26 (cancelled)

Hi Sean,

Sorry for the last-minute note — our regional VPN provider just reported a multi-region outage and our stack is effectively unreachable from external networks. The Acme ML infra team recommends we pause the hands-on kickoff for today; engineers can't reliably attach to the instances.

We'd like to reschedule. Ideally next week, but we still want to keep the weekend load window if your ops team can support that asynchronously.

Would you be able to propose a recovery plan (short sessions + a checklist for our network folks) so we can pick a firm date? Attaching a very small log excerpt below.

Thanks —
Carlos Ruiz
Head of ML Platform, Acme Corporation

Attachment: outage-snippet.txt (text)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-26T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff — recovery options and pre-checks

Hi Carlos — sorry to hear about the outage, and thanks for the heads up. We can absolutely recover this without losing momentum. Two pragmatic recovery options below — pick what fits your team and time constraints and we will execute:

Option A — Split hands-on sessions (recommended for interactive debugging)
- Session 1 (60 min): infra & connectivity checks, model endpoint staging, basic prompts + KV cache walkthrough
- Session 2 (60 min): advanced prompt routing, performance knobs, and a short load ramp (we run a targeted 15-min loadburst)
- Outcome: two calendar invites (separate hosts), all artifacts and a short recording

Option B — Asynchronous recovery + consolidated load window
- We provide a detailed runbook + networking-checklist for your infra team to run pre-checks
- We host a 90–120 minute remote load window over the weekend (Redwood run), then sync results Monday
- Outcome: fewer live attendees, good for constrained calendars

Pre-reqs / attachments: networking-checklist.pdf (pre-flight checks), proposed-schedule.ics (suggested slots)

Can you confirm which option you prefer and which timezone window works best? If Option A, we can propose concrete 60-min windows (we can do early-morning PST or late-morning ET).

If helpful, we can split responsibility: Monica leads the prompts and routing segment; Dev and I will run the endpoint & load checks.

Happy to be flexible — we want to get the hands-on work back on the calendar this week if possible.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference, Inc.

Attachments: proposed-schedule.ics (calendar), networking-checklist.pdf (PDF)
From: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@acme-corp.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme IT Ops <itops@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2027-08-27T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff — recovery options and pre-checks

Sean — thanks for two clear options. We prefer Option A (split sessions). Our team requests earlier ET times if possible because our ops staff will be back online in the morning. Proposed:
- Session 1: Mon Aug 30, 11:00–12:00 ET (infra + connectivity)
- Session 2: Mon Aug 30, 14:00–15:00 ET (prompts + short loadburst)

If you can send calendar invites for those exact slots, we'll confirm on our side. We'll also run through the networking-checklist today and share any blockers.

Appreciate the flexibility.

—Carlos
Carlos Ruiz
Head of ML Platform, Acme Corporation
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-27T10:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff — internal plan (who owns what)

Sean / Dev — quick internal note so we don't double-book:
- Monica: lead prompts & routing demo (Session 2) — bring prompt set A and the routing playbook
- Sean: lead connectivity + endpoint staging (Session 1) and run the 15-min loadburst with Redwood Optimize settings
- Dev: handle test harness + make sure the test API key and isolated model variant are set; I'll hand off runbook link to Carlos' ops team once Sean confirms endpoints

Dylan — can you prepare a short token-cost slide (1 slide) to show how batching/kv-cache impacts unit cost during the loadburst? Keep it tight.

I'll update the internal calendar and add session-1.ics / session-2.ics as soon as Sean drops them.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-28T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff Recovery: session invites + quick pre-check

Carlos — confirmed. I've created the two calendar invites and attached them here (session-1.ics, session-2.ics). Details:

Session 1 — Mon Aug 30 11:00–12:00 ET- Focus: infra & connectivity, endpoint staging- Lead: Sean Gallagher
Session 2 — Mon Aug 30 14:00–15:00 ET- Focus: prompts, routing, mini-loadburst (15 minutes)- Lead: Monica Patel

Pre-check items (action for Acme IT Ops before session 1):
1) Run networking-checklist.pdf (ping, firewall egress, NAT gateway check)
2) Confirm the test IP whitelist contains our staging host (staging-ops.redwood-inference.com)
3) Verify that your KMS has allowed our test HSM key (if you're using HSM) or share a short-term test key using your secure channel

Quick links:
- Runbook folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPOC-Runbook
- Test endpoint: https://redwood-inference.com/ops/acme/test (token-based auth)

If anything changes on your side (still seeing instability), tell us and we can switch to Option B quickly. Otherwise we will plan to run the 15-min loadburst in Session 2 at 14:30 ET and capture latency/cost metrics for the report.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: session-1.ics, session-2.ics, networking-checklist.pdf
